All middle shelves have the same dimensions in this Modular Nest Insert system, allowing you to arrange your workspace entirely according to your own taste and style. A stainless steel grill at the bottom and an acacia shelf at the top? It's up to you. You can choose between shelves made of stainless steel grill, stainless steel, or acacia. Having trouble deciding? You can always change it later.

products.title: XL Nest Handler
products.body_html: The Big Green Egg Nest Handler secures the EGG to the Nest to ensure greater stability and easier handling when rolling. The Handlers are made of durable powder-coated steel. Designed and manufactured in the USA exclusively for Big Green Egg. Recommended for all XL Nests

products.title: Table Nest for Medium EGG
products.body_html:
With the Table Nest, you literally place your Big Green Egg on a stand. It is specially designed to support the EGG and protect the table, kitchen island, or your custom-built outdoor kitchen from the heat released. Another advantage: with the Table Nest, you won't get any burn marks on the table.

The Table Nest's metal stand ensures that hot air can flow freely under the EGG. Want to integrate the Table Nest into your worktop? That's certainly possible too. It's not suitable as a standalone stand, so place it on a solid (and non-flammable) surface. Spilled something? The table stand can be cleaned with a damp cloth.

Table Nests are not suitable as freestanding stands, so place them on a solid (and non-flammable) surface. The metal stand ensures that hot air can flow freely under the EGG. Want to integrate the Table Nest into your worktop? That's certainly possible too. Spilled something? The table stand can be cleaned with a damp cloth.

DO NOT USE A TABLE NEST TO SUPPORT AN EGG UNLESS THE EGG IS HOUSED WITHIN A TABLE, ISLAND OR OTHER SURROUND.
THE LOW-PROFILE TABLE NEST IS NOT DESIGNED OR INTENDED AS A FREE-STANDING SUPPORT for your EGG. Only the Mini and MiniMax have a low-profile Nest designed to be used as a free-standing base.
THE EGG IS DESIGNED TO BE USED IN A METAL NEST OR WITH A METAL TABLE NEST, PROVIDING AN AIR GAP BELOW THE EGG - however you must exercise caution and not place an EGG directly over combustible material such as ground cover or an extremely dry wood surface even if using a Table Nest.
FOR MAXIMUM HEAT PROTECTION, IT IS BEST THAT A GRANITE TILE AND A METAL TABLE NEST BE USED IN COMBINATION, particularly if EGG is routinely used for long cooks or high temperature cooking and is placed over a wood surface.
PERIODICALLY CHECK THE AREA DIRECTLY BELOW THE EGG to ensure that over time there is no deterioration on the surface under the EGG due to heat transfer.

products.title: Caster Kit - (2 in/5cm) 2 locking 2 non-locking for all Modular Nests and Wood Tables
products.body_html:
Enhance your outdoor cooking setup with these versatile 2-inch (5 cm) casters. These 2-inch (5 cm) casters seamlessly integrate with all egg tables, nests, and handlers, providing smooth mobility and secure locking when needed. Two locking and two non-locking wheels offer the perfect balance of flexibility and control, enhancing your outdoor cooking setup. Compatible with the full range of egg accessories, these casters transform your cooking station into a versatile, mobile culinary hub.

  • Set includes: 2 locking casters, 2 non-locking casters
  • Diameter: 2 inches (5 cm)
  • Compatible with: Acacia Tables, Modular Nest Systems, IntEGGrated Nest+Handler, all egg Nests

products.title: Caster Kit - (4 in/10 cm) 1 locking 1 non-locking for Modular Nests, Nests and Wood Tables
products.body_html: Caster Kit is a matte black set with 2 swivel wheels, 1 of which has a brake, specially designed for Big Green Egg. The wheels fit on EGG Nest, Modular System, and acacia table. With the sturdy and smooth swivel wheels, you can easily move the EGG in all directions. Includes a wrench for easy assembly and disassembly of the wheels. Rotate, roll, ready. Does not work with the MiniMax nest.

products.title: Connector Pack for Modular Nest System
products.body_html:
The Connector Pack integrates your Modular Nest Frame with the Expansion Frame or Cabinet, creating a unified cooking station. Precision-engineered joints ensure rock-solid stability, while the sleek design maintains a clean aesthetic. This essential component unlocks the full potential of your outdoor kitchen, allowing for effortless customization and expansion. The corrosion-resistant stainless steel construction withstands the elements, ensuring years of reliable service.

  • Compatible with all Modular Nest System components
  • Made from 304 grade stainless steel
  • Includes all necessary hardware for installation
  • Weight: 2.2 lbs (1 kg)

products.title: Hardware Pack for Modular Nest System
products.body_html:
This comprehensive hardware pack includes every bolt, washer, and nut needed for a complete nest assembly or repair. Stainless steel construction resists corrosion, maintaining structural integrity through years of outdoor use. By integrating seamlessly with your egg system, these components provide the foundation for countless culinary adventures.

  • Includes all necessary hardware for one modular nest
  • Corrosion-resistant stainless steel
  • Compatible with all egg sizes and nest configurations

products.title: Tool Hook for Modular Nest System (works with Acacia Tables)
products.body_html:
The tool hook is a precision-engineered accessory for your egg grill. Constructed from durable powder-coated aluminum, it securely holds your essential grilling implements within easy reach. The hook attaches effortlessly to the Modular Nest System or Acacia Tables, creating a streamlined workspace that enhances your cooking workflow. Its sleek design complements the egg's iconic silhouette while providing practical functionality for the discerning outdoor chef.

  • Dimensions: 3.5 x 2.5 x 1.5 inches (8.9 x 6.4 x 3.8 cm)
  • Weight: 0.2 lbs (0.09 kg)
  • Material: Powder-coated aluminum
  • Compatible with Modular Nest System and Acacia Tables

products.title: Modular EGG Mate
products.body_html:
The Modular Nest Mate is a versatile side shelf that expands your outdoor cooking workspace. This versatile side shelf seamlessly integrates with Modular Nests, offering a sleek, screw-free top surface that complements your egg's aesthetic. When not in use, it folds vertically, preserving valuable patio space without compromising on functionality. The Nest Mate supports up to 40 lbs (18.1 kg), providing ample room for prep work, plating, or displaying your culinary creations.

  • Dimensions: 16" x 25" (40.6 cm x 63.5 cm)
  • Material: Solid acacia wood
  • Weight capacity: 40 lbs (18.1 kg)
  • Compatible with: Modular Nests only
